result.summary: Identified 2 visual issues, primarily an active loading indicator overlaid on loaded content.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar banner image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading spinner hides once the image asset is fully rendered.

issues.description: The third card title under 'Fastest near you' is abruptly cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding or text truncation styling to preview horizontal scroll smoothly.
